text.text_excerpt: I'm due for my annual trip to the strip club and then the Yelp review to follow. So here you go. First, you have to walk down that nasty ass Bourbon Street to get to this place. But think... What strip club is ever located in a classy and clean part of town? They're not. Going to the strip club is like trying to reach a goal. The vision is there full of excitement, you have to go through a bunch of crap along the process but the achievement is oh so worth all the effort! It's Thursday night so the place wasn't packed. Super fun super clean !!! Live club. The pole was so y'all the dancers were very talented and engaged with the crowd. They weren't snobbish me because I'm female. Actually got a vip room here it was so much fun and worth every penny. My only complaint was at the server who we bought multiple bottles from tipped 30% and we only saw her when she was serving the bottle. I'd understand if it was slammed but it wasn't busy inside at all. The upstairs was closed so she only had one floor to cover and only four occupied tables including ours. Other than that.. awesome establishment!

Wow what an amazing strip club! The club itself is so vibrant and clean with a luxurious feel to it and the entertainers there are stunning and friendly, with a variety of looks from alternative to glamorous, cute and sexy. Due to an unforeseen cancellation of the 'Hunk oasis' over the street our bachelorette party ended up here and the staff couldn't have been more helpful. We had bottle service in the VIP floor where we could see two stages of pole dancing (one of the poles goes right up from the bottom floor to the VIP level and some of the tricks I saw were breathtaking!!!)
